app.title: StatVidya — Workforce Competency Intelligence
app.tagline: Competency Intelligence Platform for India's Official Statistical System

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyDescription: When you receive assessments, pathway updates, or system alerts, they will appear here.

hero.title: Adaptive Competency Framework for India's Statistical Workforce
hero.subtitle: A unified platform for assessing, tracking, and enhancing the professional competencies of government statistical personnel from Field Investigators to Senior Directors, grounded strictly in the National Statistical Commission's guidelines and Mission Karmayogi's FRAC model.

pillars.title: Institutional Capabilities
pillars.subtitle: Engineered for institutional trust, regulatory compliance, and field-first statistical operations.

frac.title: Mission Karmayogi FRAC Alignment
frac.description: Grounded in the government's official Framework of Roles, Activities and Competencies with granular L1–L5 proficiency standards.

igot.title: iGOT Karmayogi Integration
igot.description: Dynamic multi-signal course recommendation engine linking diagnosed competency gaps directly to verified national learning pathways.

mcq.title: Multi-AI Consensus Question Pipeline
mcq.description: Automated generation and multi-model consensus audit of bilingual assessment items from official survey manuals and training documents.

offline.title: Field-First Offline Capability
offline.description: Progressive Web App with client-side IndexedDB persistence ensures field investigators in remote blocks can complete assessments without internet.

provenance.title: Auditable Data Provenance
provenance.description: Every competency record, question, and recommendation is permanently tagged with institutional provenance badges for total transparency.

framework.title: The FRAC Competency Architecture
framework.subtitle: Adopted by MoSPI under Mission Karmayogi to move from rule-based to role-based statistical administration.

domain.title: Domain Competencies
domain.desc: Sampling theory, survey design, national accounts, price indices, data collection methods, and statistical computing.

functional.title: Functional Competencies
functional.desc: Field investigation, CAPI tablet operations, quality scrutiny, report writing, data scrutiny, and project management.

behavioural.title: Behavioural Competencies
behavioural.desc: Integrity, public service orientation, analytical thinking, teamwork, conflict resolution, and communication.

levels.title: L1 to L5 Proficiency Scale
levels.l3: L3: Working Knowledge (Autonomous execution of standard tasks)
levels.l4: L4: Advanced Application (Complex problem solving and mentoring)
levels.l5: L5: Expert Mastery (Methodology design and strategic leadership)

cadres.title: Designed for India's Statistical Hierarchy
cadres.subtitle: Tailored interfaces, bilingual support, and assessment criteria calibrated to official service rules.

iss.title: Indian Statistical Service (ISS)
iss.desc: Senior leadership, survey planning, national macroeconomic aggregation, and institutional policymaking.

sss.title: Subordinate Statistical Service (SSS)
sss.desc: Junior Statistical Officers (JSO) and Senior Statistical Officers (SSO) conducting data supervision and analysis.

nsso.title: NSSO Field Operations Division
nsso.desc: Field Investigators executing household, agricultural, and socio-economic survey schedules on ground.

nssta.title: NSSTA Training Academy
nssta.desc: Faculty and training administrators managing curriculum, document ingestion, and question validation.

about.title: About StatVidya & Governance
about.body: StatVidya is developed to empower the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) and the National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA). Aligned with the recommendations of the National Statistical Commission and Mission Karmayogi, StatVidya bridges the gap between training delivery and measurable statistical survey quality across India.
about.contactAddress: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Plot No. 22, Knowledge Park-II, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310
